infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to use your location to set your pickup and follow your trip.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to reach devices on your local network, such as your Wi-Fi OBD-II (CANBus) reader for live vehicle data and a Wi-Fi receipt printer for the taxi meter.

plugins.bluetoothAlwaysPermission: Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to connect to Bluetooth devices such as your OBD-II (CANBus) reader for live vehicle data and a mini receipt printer for the taxi meter.
